intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna holds up two green sprigs, one in each gloved hand. They look like the same sprig, twice.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “One’s parsley. The other is fool’s parsley.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Neither sprig has a label. Everything else she carries has at least one.

options.labelText: “I have no idea. And I’m not eating either one.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Everyone else guesses. The confident ones end up in my infirmary.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She ties a paper tag to each stem, humming. One says *PARSLEY*. The other says *DON’T*.

options.labelText: “That one. Flat leaves. That’s flat-leaf parsley, isn’t it?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “They both have flat leaves. That’s the whole trick.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “You’d recover. I’d see to it. You wouldn’t enjoy how.”
